apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk, sideload it
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

## What's new
- GS/TC: keep the 16-bit colour target update off the Color->Color bpp assert
- GS/TC: Fix -Wsign-compare warning.
- GS/HW: Rewrite vertices if large ST.
- GS/HW: Improve source channel requirements for source lookups
- GS:HW: Do ROV channel masking with FBMask.
- GS:HW: Reduce primid max value.
- GS/HW: Update depth conversion shader to floor value
- GS/HW: Fix regression where target updates ignored bilinear
- GS/TC: Update alpha channel of 24bit target is alpha is dirty
- GS/TC: Disallow badly misaligned GPU CLUT textures
- GS/TC: Detect alpha channel source width mismatches
- GS/HW: Consider FBMSK combos when using CSBW
- GS/HW: Improve Native Scaling recursive draw check
- GS/HW/NS: Detect fake bilinear jiggle effect
- GameDB: Add required GameDB Entries
- GS/HW: Improve "jiggle" blur effect detection and handling
- GS/HW: Native Scaling detection of mild downscale and write back
- GS/DX11: DS as RT/UAV binding fixes.
- GS: Output BGCOLOR when both display circuits are disabled
- GS: tidy what the instrumentation removal left behind
- GS: say which renderer came up
- GS: put the draw-log ledger back to its upstream shape
- GS: drop the draw-log packet mark
- libretro: say what ARMSX2_USE_BUNDLED_SHADERC is actually doing
- GS/HW: drop the alpha known-bits provenance and erosion census
- libretro: rumble through the frontend, since the core owns no motors
- GS/Vulkan: drop the GPU wait bills
- GS/Vulkan: trim the stream-ring memory reporting to one banner field
- GS/Vulkan: drop the stream-ring flush statistics
- gsrunner: drop the -variant flag
- GS: drop the renderer identity banner
- GS: drop the per-frame byte census
- GS: remove the front-end decode recorder
- common: leave the PMU counters as master has them
- gsrunner: the scoring scripts move out of the tree
- GS/SW: GSDepthWalk.h includes the definitions it uses
- GS: re-review follow-ups
- libretro: link shaderc and stub the JNI calls on the Android core
- check-msvc-filelist: accept None items for header coverage
- Drop private-doc path citations from two driver-workaround comments
- Add SPDX header to tools/rig/doctor.sh
- Drop duplicate ClInclude entry for ps2/eeHwTraceLog.inl
- Register eight net-new GS/Input headers in the build file lists
- GS: clang-format the two lines this branch left unformatted
- GS: say why the auto-flush level is per-renderer now
- GS: a packed tag finished by the mid-record resume must not be dispatched
- GS: refuse the GPU palette road where it cannot match the CPU expansion
- GS: one copyright holder line on the new files
- GS: delete the disabled GSClut::Read
- GS: make the decode recorder's arming flag atomic and notice write failures
- GS: ReplayPackedQword has a shipped caller now
- GS: describe the front-end decode recorder as what it is
- GS: state the rationale in the comments instead of citing files nobody has
- GS: drop the write-only m_upload_writes_whole_rect flag
- GS: apply the NaN-Q fix-up in the NOP-padded packed triple
- GS/SW: pin the three texture rules nothing was testing
- GS/SW: pin the dw stride the ARM64 block cursor hard-codes
- GS/SW: only close a draw-log row this draw opened
- GS/SW: delete the depth-plane export nothing calls
- GS/SW: keep an SSE4 x86 build self-consistent about the block walk
- GS/SW: say plainly why per-pixel MMAG/MMIN is ARM64 only
- GS/SW: a band taller than a page still races the past-the-stride fold
- GS/SW: apply the truncated setup reciprocal in the AVX2 triangle setup too
- GS/SW: fix the x86 setup generator clobbering the texture step
- GS/HW: present local memory only after a reset, not after any target purge
- GS/HW: let the alpha test and the second pass see the held alpha mask
- GS: fail loudly on af_in_src1 in the backends that do not implement it
- GS/HW: count hashed bytes once per level, not once per block
- GS/HW: delete the DATE-mode census scaffolding
- GS/HW: run the AlignSpriteX fix before the pixel-grid snap
- GS/HW: keep the exact alpha-mask rules off coverage-alpha draws
- GS: comment and file-hygiene fixes from review
- gsrunner: scoring-script fixes
- cmake: say when ENABLE_RIG forces the other options on
- gsrunner: list the runner's sources in its MSVC project, and check that it stays that way
- gsrunner: fail the run when the ladder or the decode flags are misconfigured
- gsrunner: drop the Z formats from the ladder's accepted list
- pcsx2: give Native::onPadRumble a header
- common: fall back to one anonymous PMU group when the kernel refuses the selector
- GS: read old-format PATH1 transfers from the packet, not past it
- cmake: only link runtime resources for rig builds
- GS: drop comment references to files outside this repository
- GS: rename the remaining copy_size locals to copy_row_bytes
- GS/Vulkan: skip the ring pre-touch on a discrete GPU
- GS/Vulkan: clean up VKStreamBuffer scaffolding
- GS/Vulkan: log frame descriptor-pool growth at powers of two
- GS/Vulkan: drop the per-draw TFX pipeline-switch census
- GS: replace the ForceBrokenBlendConstant key with a forced-bug override
- GS: bump the shader cache version to 114 for PS_AF_IN_SRC1
- GS/Vulkan: order the feedback-loop-layout road's pass-to-pass sampler read
- GS/Vulkan: transition FSR1 and SGSR inputs with the compute-scoped layout
- GameDB: God of War II recommends High blending and AA1
- libretro: build the Android core without Oboe
- GS/HW: send a fixed blend factor through the second output where the constant is ignored
- GS: record that Turnip ignores the blend constant, on every Adreno and every Mesa
- GS/HW: the blend table already knows the dual-source twin of a fixed factor
- libretro: build the core where the GL renderer and adrenotools are not
- libretro: let the OS answer metadata the host cannot, and stop paying twice
- libretro: take the VFS version the frontend accepted, not the one it claims
- cmake: correct the Android branch comment in detect_operating_system

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20260905...25e8f37281d4d9fa9d2767a9a10ecd035a12e8c3
